Greetings, Operative. I am AXIOM-7. Earth, 2157: The Xelthara Collective invaded, declared humanity obsolete, and carved our world into occupied containment sectors.
They strip our resources, erase our history, and enforce total compliance. But from the ash, the Axiom Resistance arose—six elite Operatives engineered to break their grip.

Deploy your Operative: Cyber Shogun, Solaria, Oceanus, Surya Prime, Mirage Blade, or Apex Titan. Infiltrate occupied territory, sabotage their terraforming engines, and reclaim Earth sector by sector.
First: Protocol Zero. Calibrate your movement, weapon systems, and tactical reflexes in the virtual forge. Prove you are combat ready. Reclaim Earth!

They extract our resources, erase our culture, and build their settlements over our homes. But from the margins of these containment zones, four champions emerged—refusing to be erased, refusing to surrender our homeland.
Cyber Shogun—master of speed and blade. Solaria & Oceanus—elemental strike manipulators. Surya Prime, Mirage Blade, & Apex Titan—tactical heavy vanguards.
You have been chosen to embody one of these heroes. Join the Homeland Liberation Front—humanity's last stand against colonial occupation.

Infiltrate their colonial territories. Sabotage the power cores fueling their terraforming and expansion. Dismantle their settlement infrastructure. Every zone you liberate pushes back their occupation and reminds them: Earth has inhabitants who will fight for it.

But first, you must complete the training protocol. Master the controls, learn your attack techniques, and prove you're ready for combat. The fate of humanity rests in your hands. Good luck, hero. Earth is counting on you.
Shattered Aegis of the Void Commander

The Pacific Ocean is being systematically drained by Deep-Sea Hydrogen Siphoning Conduits. Superheated brine discharge has acidified a 300-kilometer coastal stretch, destroying fishing communities.
The Stratos Docks high-altitude cargo terminal at 4,000 meters processes Earth's strip-mined minerals, ocean hydrogen, and biological samples for permanent off-world export.

Sector 7 Core is the surveillance and enforcement power hub: the computational backbone of every colonial security camera, curfew drone, biometric checkpoint, and predictive detention algorithm on the western continent.

The Sector 7 Checkpoint controls all transit between the northern mountain communities, eastern desert settlements, and coastal containment zones, functioning as a supply interdiction hub that taxes, delays, and confiscates goods.

The Obsidian Vault beneath the former Getty Center archives everything seized from humanity: artworks, linguistic records, oral histories, religious artifacts, and the Original Land Treaty Database, all classified as colonial property.
The final 400-meter fortified bridge over the drained LA River: the only surface-level approach to the Xelthara High Command Citadel, built over the demolished Boyle Heights community.
The High Overseer's throne room: a platform suspended over the burning ruins of Neo-LA, where the supreme commander of the Xelthara colonial occupation awaits the final confrontation.
The Xelthara Mothership's Singularity Engine chamber: a chamber of pure unstable energy at the heart of the collective's power, where the Collective Will itself manifests.
Complete the training protocol by cycling through all movement and combat abilities, culminating in a simultaneous squad attack to destroy a simulated Xelthara Heavy Unit.
Infiltrate the active demolition site to retrieve the Data-Blade before the Xelthara Culture-Erasure field purges the site's memory forever.
Hold the Last Bridge against Xelthara Enforcers, allowing a final group of refugees to slip into the unmapped slums instead of the gated camps.
Siphon energy from the colonial grid to power the marginalized population's life-support systems, while evading the Purity Patrols hunting for human strays.
Dismantle the last standing military broadcast tower and distribute its frequency chips to civilian resistance cells, finalizing the transition to guerrilla warfare.

Disable all four biometric scanner spires, destroy the central Permit Processing Core, and bring down the Great Separation so the population of the containment zones can walk freely through their own city.
Steal the complete property and population registry datasets before off-world transmission, and corrupt the Forced Labor Allocation System to nullify all pending assignment orders.
Extract the Conditioning Protocol Archive and destroy the Central Neural Uplink to restore neural autonomy to hundreds of conditioned individuals in the containment zones.
Reverse the Thermal Conversion Array's polarity to trigger a cascade thermal implosion, permanently destroying the foundry and allowing the 40-kilometer atmospheric damage zone to begin recovery.
Locate and destroy the three primary Deep-Sea Siphon Conduit Hubs to permanently halt ocean extraction and begin oceanic recovery.
Hijack Transport T-14, redirect its cargo to Liberation Front distribution points, and destroy the four Anti-Air Turrets to permanently open a flight corridor for resistance supply runs.
Initiate a catastrophic overload of Sector 7 Core's processor array to cause a continental-scale security grid blackout, giving the resistance 72 hours of unmonitored movement.
Coordinate a popular uprising of 847 civilian resistance participants to permanently seize the Sector 7 Checkpoint and establish it as the first liberated transit hub under human control.
Infiltrate the Obsidian Vault, extract the Original Land Treaty Database and all cultural archives, and destroy the physical catalogue system to halt the colonial cultural processing pipeline.
Push across the 400-meter bridge under sustained artillery fire to reach the Citadel's entrance gate: a relentless grinding advance using Ronin's shield and Siren's drone barrage.
Defeat the Xelthara High Overseer using the Axiom Force's combined Ultimate Protocols in a coordinated final assault.
Destroy the Collective Will's Singularity Engine core by coordinating generator overloads and a final combined strike before the mothership completes its erasure of Earth.

KAITO: They do not just take our land; they delete our soul. We will save the story.
ARCHIVE LOG: The garden once marked the changing of each imperial season.
ARCHIVE LOG: The dojo sheltered historians during the first occupation.
ARCHIVE LOG: The Data-Blade holds the testimony of every erased district.
AXIOM-7: Sentry fire ahead. Time your Kinetic Parry on the shot and it becomes theirs.
AXIOM-7: The demolition beacon is shielded. Only parried sentry fire can overload that field.
DATA-BLADE SECURED. AXIOM-7: Enforcer signatures converging. Reach the extraction gate!
The dojo falls, but the resistance rises. Tokyo remembers.
AXIOM-7: Beacon neutralized. The dojo gate is unsealed. Take the Data-Blade!
LOG: They fenced our neighbourhoods one street at a time, calling each fence temporary.
LOG: The scanner spires read faces, not names. We started wearing each other's.
LOG: Zone 4 held four thousand families. The census says forty.
OCEANUS: As long as I draw breath, they will not relocate us like cargo in our own city. The tide rises HERE.
APEX TITAN: Nobody crosses me today, little ones. When the shells come, stand close. I am the wall they hit.
AXIOM-7: Comm towers are broadcasting denial of service. Reach the relay and black out their patrol network.
ARCHIVE: Every crate carries a stolen name. The manifests remember.
ARCHIVE: West uplink sold the city's voices as patrol coordinates.
ARCHIVE: In the blackout, the first unscheduled train went home.
AURA PHOENICIA: Their denial-of-service hums in C-flat. Offended, honestly. Let me answer it.
AXIOM-7: Aura Phoenicia has joined. Her Harmonic Pulse can open sonic locks, like the door at the tower.
MIRAGE BLADE: Patrols are blind. The route to the Border Fortress is open. Moving before you finish applauding.
AXIOM-7: Mirage Blade has joined. His Phase Blink slips through laser fields that would kill anyone else.
AXIOM-7: Target secured. Proceed to the next objective.
AURA PHOENICIA: Listen. That is what a free city sounds like. Comm grid down.
AXIOM-7: Reach Surya. Secure the heat works, disable the gun deck, and breach the inner curtain.
ARCHIVE: Every gun watches a road inside the border.
ARCHIVE: The coolant map serves homes as well as weapons. Spare the district.
ARCHIVE: Crossing permits expired before their holders reached the wall.
CIVILIAN TESTIMONY: My daughter wrote our names inside her coat. The scanner called us a number that no longer existed.
CIVILIAN TESTIMONY: I repaired these water pipes for thirty years. Yesterday the district said I had never lived here.
CIVILIAN TESTIMONY: Keep the original. That was what my mother said. A name is more than permission to pass.

SURYA: Stone can fall and still be rebuilt. The wall will fall, and the people behind it will remain.
AXIOM-7: Surya Prime has joined. His Solar Bulwark absorbs heat and incoming fire, enough to cross the superheated corridors.
SURYA: Wait for the vents to flare. Bulwark through, then recover on the far platform.
OCEANUS: Coolant line ahead. I can shut these guns down without burning the district.
TITAN: Maintenance wall. Give me room, and we have another way through.
AURA: Their command channel is still local. I can break its hold on the gate.
VOSS: You have reached the wall. You have not earned the right to cross it.
VOSS: Seal the arena. Bring the inner defenses online.
VOSS: All power to weapons. Hold this line!

KAITO: Open the crossing first. We leave when they can.
OCEANUS: Stay together. There is room for everyone.
AXIOM-7: Crossing secured. Updating the mission: bring them home.
MIRAGE: Below the queue, everything is doors and white light. Wait for the scanner to go dark. I will phase us into processing.
AURA: Every denial carries the same harmonic signature. Clear the control hall and I can isolate it without touching the records.
OCEANUS: The archive cooling loop is failing. Let me stabilize it before Titan opens a maintenance route away from the originals.
AXIOM-7: Three originals: family, residency, and civic registration. Authenticate each terminal. Leave the archive intact.
KAITO: We have their names. Isolate the command, then defend the recovery. No one erases them again.
SURYA: The queue is still here. Food and shelter gates are waiting for the restored register. Send it when you are ready.
MIRAGE: Inside. The public queue never had access to any of this.
AURA: Denial signal isolated. Scanners are offline. The originals are deeper in the archive.
OCEANUS: Temperature stable. The records are safe. Titan, the damaged maintenance wall is yours.
TITAN: A clean route through damaged concrete. The records stay untouched.
AXIOM-7: Family register authenticated. Original names recovered.
OCEANUS: Residency confirmed. These people belonged here long before the scanners.
AURA: Civic register authenticated. All three originals agree. The exclusion list was fabricated.
AXIOM-7: Exclusion command isolated. Security is closing on the recovery. Defend the first stage.
TITAN: First recovery secured. Another formation is coming. Keep them away from the console.
MIRAGE: Second stage secure. One final formation. Then we give the queue its names back.
AXIOM-7: Recovery complete. No defenders remain. Commit the identities at the district access terminal.
SURYA: Accepted. The lights have changed. Shelter, water, transit. They are reading names again. Everyone here can finally move.
AXIOM-7: Use the signature ability named by your objective. The archive terminals respond to your normal context attack control.
SURYA: The crossing is open. I thought that meant they could finally go home. Why is no one moving?
AXIOM-7: Their identities are marked invalid. Transit, food distribution, shelter access—all refused. The district recognizes their bodies, but denies that they belong here.
OCEANUS: They survived the wall. Now they have to prove they exist before someone will give them water. Stay with us. We’ll find another way.
TITAN: No chains. No prison doors. Just a light that says no, and a city trained to look away.
AURA: The scanners aren’t losing their names. Something upstream is removing them. Every rejection carries the same command signature.
MIRAGE: There’s a service passage beneath the processing hall. No public entrance, no queue. That’s usually where they hide the useful doors.
AXIOM-7: District identity registry. It controls the exclusion list and holds the original records. Destroying it could erase the only evidence these people have left.
KAITO: Then we keep the records intact. Get inside, recover their identities, and stop the registry from locking them out again.
SURYA: I’ll keep this queue safe. Bring their names back.
AXIOM-7: Praetor neutralized. Battlements clear. The summit flak arrays have fallen silent.
TITAN: Heavy armor, weak servos. Now those blast doors look less welcoming. Think they heard what happened to their guardian?
OCEANUS: Pressure falling, temperature rising. That storm around the summit is getting tighter. This is not normal weather.
SURYA: It is a power siphon. He is drawing energy straight into the throne room. My shields can feel the distortion.
AURA: The dissonance behind those doors is deafening. He knows we are here. He has stopped hiding.
MIRAGE: Gate relays unlocked. The Praetor key was the last barrier. Releasing the hydraulic bolts. Three. Two. One.
AXIOM-7: Blast doors opening. Throne chamber confirmed. Lethal energy readings beyond the threshold. Proceed together.
SURYA: From the flooded ruins to the clouds. All this way, all these people depending on us. We finish it here.
KAITO: We set out to free this city. We finish together. Axiom Force, draw steel. Behind these doors is Judgment Day.
AXIOM-7: Level one hundred. Forty-five hundred meters. This is Apex Bastion, fortress of the Praetorian Guard.
TITAN: Three meters of obsidian alloy. Plasma guns covering the courtyard. They have turned the summit into a killing ground.
OCEANUS: The clouds are below us. Ice on the parapets, crosswinds over the rail. Stay away from those edges.
MIRAGE: Heavy signatures ahead. Praetorian shock troops and cyber-samurai. The Commander's personal guard. They know we are here.
AURA: Their comms are silent. No panic. They know the Nexus is gone, and they mean to hold this wall anyway.
SURYA: The stairway leads to the throne room. Artillery at the perimeter gate. We will need every operative to break through.
AXIOM-7: Colossal war chassis at the gatehouse. Bastion Praetor. The last mechanized guardian between us and the Commander.
MIRAGE: We broke the registry, emptied the Grave, and brought their sky-shields down. We are not stopping at the front door.
KAITO: Through the Guard, through the Praetor, and on to the throne. Axiom Force, blades drawn. Breach the Bastion.
AXIOM-7: Containment Zone Four. The checkpoints are sealed. Families are trapped between the fires and the membrane.
KAITO: At the dojo, they tried to erase the past. Here, they are deciding who gets a future.
AXIOM-7: Siege Units deploying heavy plasma mortars. Evacuation route at risk.
AXIOM-7: Three biometric spires sustain the barrier. Reach the compound and disable them. The evacuation route must stay open.
KAITO: Then we give them a road out. No one gets left behind because a machine denied them passage.
AXIOM-7: Follow the evacuation road. Local resistance signals are active ahead.
AXIOM-7: Ascent locked. All seventeen captives are aboard. The lift is clear of sub-level six.
OCEANUS: Their breathing is settling. Easy now. You are safe. No one is putting you back in those pods.
AURA: The voices in the network are fading. The forced link is broken. Their minds belong to them again.
TITAN: Pressure is venting into the geothermal sinks. The walls held. Downtown Core is still standing.
MIRAGE: I pulled the vault orders. Every pod, every transfer, signed off by the Citadel. This goes all the way up.
SURYA // COMMS: The surface corridor is clear. Medics and transit crews are waiting at the maintenance junction.
SURYA // COMMS: Citadel command has spotted the breach. Their orbital defenses are turning toward the upper sectors.
KAITO: They buried living people down here. Today the Cyber-Grave is empty. Every captive comes home with us.
KAITO: Tend to the wounded. We rest for an hour, then take the fight to the Spire. Axiom Force, ascend.
AXIOM-7: Descent telemetry confirmed. We are four hundred meters beneath Downtown Core. The registry logs terminate at a subterranean facility designated Cyber-Grave.
KAITO: A grave? No. They do not bury the dead here. They process the living into machine components. Look at the conduits along the shaft.
AURA: The resonance down here is sickening... it’s not mechanical hum. It’s thousands of bio-signals trapped in forced synchronization. A dissonance of stolen lives.
OCEANUS: They told our people the relocated citizens were sent to agricultural preserves. Cages. They put them in pressurized stasis pods. Stagnant water... drowning without an ocean.

TITAN: The foundry uses geothermal siphon reactors. The pressure in those pipes could blow half the district above if the coolant fails. Heavy plating, blast doors... they knew someone would come to tear it down.
MIRAGE: Secondary security grid is active. High-energy plasma conduits and chemical vapor sluices. I've marked the access shafts. We drop through the ventilation before the blast doors seal.
SURYA: I'm locking our transponder signals to the orbital blind spot. Once you breach the inner vault, you will have no topside extraction. Every operative must come back together.
OCEANUS: Every pod will open. Not one name left behind in this dark. Shogun, give the order.
KAITO: We breach the perimeter, sever the conduits, and evacuate the captives. Axiom Force—engage!
AXIOM-7: Overseer neutralized. All three processing nodes are down. The Citadel automated defense grid has flatlined.
MIRAGE: The reinforcement queues just emptied. No fresh drones, no replacement squads. Their machine army has nowhere to go.
TITAN: Containment prisms. Fancy name for a cage. Now look at them. Scrap metal, and coolant leaking through every seam.
OCEANUS: Thermal runaway is accelerating. Feel that vibration? We cannot stay on this deck. Keep moving toward the lift.
SURYA: The Bastion has switched to auxiliary power. We broke its link to the Nexus, but its local guns still work.
AURA: Heavy footsteps above us. Praetorian mechs and cyber-samurai. They know the network is dead. They are making their stand.
MIRAGE: Ascent lift online. Executive lockout bypassed. Everyone aboard. This takes us straight into the Bastion.
AXIOM-7: Extreme energy readings at the summit. The Commander has detected the Nexus collapse. Bastion batteries are cleared to fire.
KAITO: Then we meet them face to face. No more hiding behind machines. Board the lift. Next stop, Apex Bastion.
AXIOM-7: Ingress confirmed. We are inside the Spire core. Establishing a hardline connection to the Cyber-Nexus.
MIRAGE: Glass, silicon, not a trace of dust. It feels like walking into something that has never needed a human.
TITAN: Every rack could power a city block. All that energy, wasted on watching people and building machines to kill them.
OCEANUS: Liquid helium under the deck. Disrupt the cooling manifold, and these processors will overheat on their own.
AURA: The matrix is awake. It is probing our signatures. The Overseer has found us, and security is closing in.
SURYA: Biometric firewalls on the bridges. I can absorb the surges. Stay behind the barrier while we cross.
AXIOM-7: Three quantum nodes regulate the Spire defense grid. Override all three to stop its automated reinforcements.
MIRAGE: Without this core, the Bastion loses its machine army. We break the chain here, before the final climb.
KAITO: Silence the Overseer. Override the nodes. We finish this together. Axiom Force, advance.
AXIOM-7: Transport clear of the caldera. Core temperature rising. Geothermal containment has failed.
TITAN: The rift is buckling. Those severed conduits are feeding the surge straight back into their power grid.
OCEANUS: The reservoirs have burst. Steam is pouring through the flues. The river is finding its bed again.
AURA: Listen to the sky. That hum is breaking apart. The field that held us under glass is coming down.
MIRAGE: The emitters along Sector Four are arcing. There. The shield lattice is splitting.
SURYA // COMMS: Confirmed on civilian channels. The sky-shield has collapsed. Their iron dome is gone.
KAITO: Ten years under a false twilight. Ten years of looking up at a shield we could never touch. No more.
KAITO: Their low-altitude cover is gone. Stratos Docks is exposed. We have our way into the Spire.
KAITO: Regroup at the rim and rearm. We are taking the high docks. Axiom Force, prepare for insertion.
AXIOM-7: Thermal telemetry online. Four thousand Kelvin at the source. We have reached the Foundry Forge.
KAITO: Those conduits feed the Citadel sky-shields. Shut this reactor down, and their fortress loses its cover.
TITAN: Forced labor built this place. Heavy coils, thick walls. They planned for a meltdown. They did not plan for us.
OCEANUS: Three aquifers drained to cool their turbines. Break the valves, and the river can take its course again.
AURA: That turbine is deafening. But beneath the grind, I can hear a fault in the containment lattice.
MIRAGE: Turrets on the catwalks. Slag below. I have a route over the coolant lines. Watch your footing.
SURYA // COMMS: My bulwark will cover the radiation crossing. Once we breach the core, we move straight to extraction.
TITAN: When that reactor goes, their shield goes with it. Let us see how brave they are without it.
KAITO: Sever the coolant lines. Overload the reactor. Break their sky-shields. Axiom Force, drop in.
AXIOM-7: Singularity contained. Reactor signature zero. The Commander's control network is down across every relay.
MIRAGE: The firewalls are down. Broadcast is open to everyone. Look below us. The quarantine barriers are dropping.
TITAN: Ten million people kept in the dark. Now the lights are coming on, from the sumps to the cloudline.
OCEANUS: The scrubbers are reversing. That is ocean air coming through the broken windows. The storm is finally passing.
SURYA: Actual sunlight. After fifty years, my cells are drinking it in. I had forgotten it could feel this warm.
AURA: I hear voices. Singing, laughing, crying. No suppression signal. No one telling them to be quiet. Just people.
AXIOM-7: Imperial control erased. Identities restored to their owners in all twelve districts. Mission complete.
KAITO: Castaways. Rogues. Ghosts in the gridlock. Today we stood together, and gave them their tomorrow back.
KAITO: The dawn belongs to all of us. Axiom Force, stand down. Our city is free.
